name: Delivery plan commitment level code
description: Code specifying the level of commitment to a delivery plan.

values.name: Firm
values.description: Firm Indicates that the scheduling information is a firm commitment.

values.name: Commitment for manufacturing and material
values.description: Commitment for manufacturing and material Authorizes the supplier to start the manufacturing of goods.

values.name: Commitment for material
values.description: Commitment for material Authorizes the manufacturer to order material required for manufacturing specified goods.

values.name: Planning/forecast
values.description: Planning/forecast An estimate of future requirements based on trends and actual information.

values.name: Short delivered on previous delivery
values.description: Short delivered on previous delivery Part of a consignment which was not delivered when the original delivery was made.

values.name: Capacity available
values.description: Capacity available Capacity is available to meet the requested scheduling demands.

values.name: Promotion
values.description: Promotion All related schedule information refer to a promotion.

values.name: Special demand
values.description: Special demand All related schedule information refers to a special demand.

values.name: User defined
values.description: User defined The user can interpret the meaning of the values from information exchanged previously.

values.name: Immediate
values.description: Immediate Indicates that the scheduling information is for immediate execution.

values.name: Pilot/Pre-volume
values.description: Pilot/Pre-volume Initial products required in advance of the normal production process.

values.name: Planning
values.description: Planning An estimate of future requirements.

values.name: Potential order increase
values.description: Potential order increase The possibility and magnitude of a schedule fluctuation.

values.name: Average plant usage
values.description: Average plant usage The usual amount that a manufacturing facility will use over a specified duration.

values.name: First time reported firm
values.description: First time reported firm Initial confirmation of a material requirement.

values.name: Maximum
values.description: Maximum The highest attainable amount.

values.name: Tooling capacity
values.description: Tooling capacity The maximum amount that the process was designed to accommodate.

values.name: Normal tooling capacity
values.description: Normal tooling capacity The anticipated amount that the process was designed to accommodate over a specific period of time.

values.name: Prototype
values.description: Prototype The preliminary version of a product or service.

values.name: Strike protection
values.description: Strike protection Product level that is set aside as protection in the event of a work stoppage.

values.name: Required tooling capacity
values.description: Required tooling capacity The contracted amount that the process was designed to accommodate over a specific period of time.

values.name: Deliver to schedule
values.description: Deliver to schedule Deliver to schedule separately supplied.

values.name: Await manual pull
values.description: Await manual pull Await non-EDI instruction before shipping.

values.name: Reference to commercial agreement between partners
values.description: Reference to commercial agreement between partners The buyer's commitment is the one defined in the commercial agreement.

values.name: Proposed
values.description: Proposed Indicates that the scheduling information is a proposal.
